messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync BrightEdge renewal — they want to move from PAYG to a 12-month commit with an uplift. Asking for predictable spend and some Dedicated isolation options. Looping @Priya @Mateo @Jenna.

Priya Nair: Got it. CS usage metrics: ~3.2M tokens/mo, current ARR ~ $120k. They want to guarantee capacity for Q3 and cut variance.

Mateo Garcia: For the POC we need acceptance criteria. Propose p95 latency < 300ms, throughput >= 50 reqs/s, and acceptance flows for search rerank + chat. They currently run `redwood-7b-oc`. Could offer `redwood-7b-quant` + KV prefix cache to lower unit cost. Example config we used: 
```
model: redwood-7b-quant
max_tokens: 512
batching: continuous
cache_prefix: true
```
Batching/caching will change effective price-per-token.

Jenna Ortiz: Deal desk flags: customer asked for 25% uplift discount and 60-day net. If they push >20% we need Pricing approval and VP signoff for >25% or custom T&Cs. Also need PO/invoice requirements.

Alex Chen: Customer's informal ask: ~3x run-rate -> ~360k/yr. Proposal idea: 12-mo commit at 15% commit discount + optional Dedicated as an add-on. If they insist on 25% we escalate. Also check if Dedicated requires SOW + extra monthly.

Jenna Ortiz: I'll create draft quote with 15% commit and line item for Dedicated (monthly infra fee + per-token usage). Pre-stage pricing packet in case they demand deeper concession.

Lucas Park: Security flagged: they sent a long questionnaire asking about data retention, encryption, and logging. If they go Dedicated, need SOW addendum + SOC2 cert & KMS details. I'll start the addendum and ping SecOps for a data-flow diagram template. Any custom indemnities? Not known yet.

Priya Nair: I'll build a short POC acceptance checklist and attach adoption slides. Proposed POC acceptance: latency <300ms p95 on host model, 99.9% uptime during business hours, and two validated flows (rerank + chat). ETA: tomorrow EOD.

Mateo Garcia: Once checklist is live I'll compare perf & cost delta between `redwood-7b-oc` and `redwood-7b-quant` using their sample payloads. Need avg tokens/request from BrightEdge to model costs and cache hit assumptions.

dealdesk-bot: Quote Q-2026-3821 created by @Jenna Ortiz (status: draft). Link: https://app.redwood.io/quotes/Q-2026-3821

Alex Chen: Plan of action: Priya finalizes checklist; Mateo runs perf/cost analysis; Jenna drafts quote with 15% and Dedicated option; Lucas drafts SOW addendum + security artifacts. Friday 10am PT follow-up with customer. If blockers appear before then, post here.

Priya Nair: Confirmed Friday 10am PT. I'll invite BrightEdge + attach security questionnaire and adoption metrics.

Jenna Ortiz: I'll prepare the pricing approval packet in parallel (incl. ratecard `2026-enterprise-ratecard-v3.pdf` and cost-per-token one-pager).

Lucas Park: I'll tag legal flags in the ticket and request SecOps for the architecture diagram template.

Alex Chen: Thanks team. Tag anything urgent here.
